# Goodall Electrical

> Family-owned electrical, audio visual, control & automation, communications and TV antenna contractor based in Sale, Victoria, servicing all of Gippsland. Licensed electricians (ACN 684 711 224), 24/7 emergency callout, fixed hourly rates: $149 inc GST service call (first 30 min, business hours), $125/hr + GST after that, $195/hr + GST after-hours and weekends.

Goodall Electrical is a single licensed crew covering five trades — electrical, audio visual, control & automation (including CBUS), communications/networking, and TV antenna installation — for residential and commercial customers across Gippsland, Victoria, Australia. Phone: 03 4130 5012. Email: info@goodallelectrical.com.au.

## Services

- [Electrical](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-electrical.html): Switchboard upgrades, EV chargers, three-phase, rewires, lighting, compliance.
- [Audio Visual](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-audio-visual.html): Venue AV for pubs, clubs and function rooms — source switching, multi-zone audio, projectors, touch-panel control.
- [Control & Automation](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-control-automation.html): Lighting, HVAC and venue control automation (Crestron, KNX, custom).
- [CBUS Lighting Control](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-control-automation-cbus.html): Wired CBUS lighting/automation network installation, wall plate design, scene control.
- [Communications & Networks](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-communications.html): Structured cabling, Wi-Fi design, CCTV, EFTPOS/POS networks.
- [TV Antennas](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/service-antennas.html): New installs, storm-damage repair, signal diagnosis, extra TV points. Matchmaster antennas as standard.

Each of the five services above also has dedicated pages for all 20 individual Gippsland towns served — e.g. `/service-electrical-sale.html`, `/service-antennas-maffra.html`, `/service-audio-visual-bairnsdale.html`, `/service-control-automation-traralgon.html`, `/service-communications-morwell.html` — see [the sitemap](https://www.goodallelectrical.com.au/sitemap.html) for the full list (100 town pages total).

## Service area

All of Gippsland, Victoria, Australia, based in Sale. Full town list: Sale, Maffra, Stratford, Heyfield, Rosedale, Longford, Newry, Boisdale, Briagolong, Tinamba, Cowwarr, Glengarry, Munro, Loch Sport, Seaspray, Golden Beach, Bairnsdale, Traralgon, Morwell, Yarram, Wonthaggi, Warragul.
